context: Two managers prep an overseas-investor briefing
purpose: Teach: 携わる/撤回/合衆国/経常/在籍/厳選/法規/位置付け

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 明日の合衆国からの投資家向け説明会、資料の最終確認をお願いできますか。
lines.en: Could you do the final check on the materials for tomorrow's briefing for investors from the United States?
lines.style: Polite, composed, focused on getting things ready efficiently.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: もちろんです。経常利益の推移グラフ、去年の数字を一部修正したので確認してください。
lines.en: Of course. I revised some of last year's figures on the recurring profit trend graph, so please take a look.
lines.style: Calm, business-like, slightly cautious about accuracy here.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。あと、前回の発表で出た見通しの一部を撤回することになりましたよね。
lines.en: That helps. Also, we ended up having to retract part of the outlook from the last presentation, right?
lines.style: Measured, faintly apologetic, professional concern, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、その件は冒頭で触れて、現行の海外法規に沿った修正方針を説明する流れにしましょう。
lines.en: Yes, let's touch on that at the start and explain the revised policy in line with current overseas regulations.
lines.style: Strategic, structured, thinking aloud about flow.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: なるほど。この案件には本社の法務にも長く携わる田中さんに同席してもらえると安心です。
lines.en: I see. It would be reassuring to have Tanaka-san, who's been involved with HQ legal for years, sit in on this.
lines.style: Collaborative, respectful, leaning on senior expertise.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 田中さんはまだ在籍されてますし、頼んでみましょう。資料も厳選した数字だけに絞った方がいいですね。
lines.en: Tanaka-san is still on the roster, so let's ask him. We should also pare the materials down to only carefully selected figures.
lines.style: Decisive, practical, focused on tightening the deck cleanly.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 同感です。今回の説明会、当社にとって北米市場での位置付けを左右する大事な場ですから。
lines.en: I agree. This briefing is a critical occasion that will shape how we're positioned in the North American market.
lines.style: Earnest, stakes-aware, emphasizing importance of the moment.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 気合い入れていきましょう。今晩中にリハーサル一回、通しでやりませんか。
lines.en: Let's bring our A-game. Shall we do one full run-through rehearsal sometime tonight?
lines.style: Encouraging, mildly energetic, action-oriented closing, tone matching the moment with quiet honesty
